Troubleshooting · 12/50 · editing

Proxy media will not relink

Failure signal

A proxy media will not relink condition is reported or detected during editing.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for editing does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Compare reel names, timecode, frame rate, path mapping and source identifiers.

Corrective action

Normalize metadata in a reversible map and test relink on a duplicate project.

Prevention

Add this verification to the editing gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
